Marta (Partnerships): Quick sync: were trying to finalize multi-cloud listing items this week. Key blockers: pricing schema, legal attestation, and publisher account access.
Devon (Marketplace): AWS needs AMI IDs + product code; GCP wants container + license; Azure needs offer.json and demo screenshots.
Aisha (Cloud): I'll produce AMIs for us-east-1 and europe-west1 and push container to gcr.io/redwood/marketplace:release-candidate. Need publisher invites.
Rohit (Legal): I'll prepare a short attestation for telemetry and a BYOL addendum if needed. Expect draft in 48h.
Devon (Marketplace): I can start portal entries once I have assets. Can someone confirm the 1024x1024 logo and privacy URL?
Marta (Partnerships): Logo is in shared drive: /marketing/marketplace/logo_1024.png. Privacy URL is https://redwood.example.com/privacy.
Aisha (Cloud): Invites requested from Devon for AWS/GCP. Also adding a CI job to produce AMI IDs: `ci/build-ami --tag=rc1`.
ops-bot: Publisher invite sent to aisha@redwood. Token valid 72h.
Marta (Partnerships): OK owners: Aisha = artifacts, Devon = portal + submission, Rohit = legal. Aim to submit by Friday to hit validation window.
Devon (Marketplace): On it. I'll post the submission checklist when ready.
Rohit (Legal): Will post attestation and flag any export controls.
Marta (Partnerships): Thanks team. Follow-up sync Friday 9am PT.
